narrative.details:
From the corpse of the defeated serpent you uncover what appears to be a note of some importance: A letter from his superior, General Drakkisath, concerning protocol.

Your instinct tells you that you should take it to Marshal Maxwell.
narrative.objectives: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.
narrative.requestItemsText: What have you got there, adventurer?
